versions.changelog:
- Updated MCP server URL from `https://mcp.trainedby.ai/mcp` to `https://trainedby.fastmcp.app/mcp`.  
- No other changes to features, tools, or guidelines.

- Initial release of the trainedby-mcp skill.
- Connects to the trainedby.ai MCP server for personal coaching, health tracking, and goal management.
- Supports user authentication via Supabase OAuth.
- Provides tools for timeline summaries, semantic search, note saving, onboarding, and user feedback.
- Enables tracking of goals, workouts, reflections, and progress with guided coaching guidelines.
